concept: THE MACHINE KNOWS WHERE IT IS. Under Arctic sea ice a satellite cannot reach, so the Navy proposes solving a robot's position with sound, six moored 900 Hz sources it trilaterates off. The film admires that plainly, then turns on a real asymmetry: the permit's no-harm finding rests on a Beaufort beluga count from 1992 and, for ESA-threatened Arctic ringed seals, no count at all. You cannot measure harm to a population you have not counted. Comments close August 21.
palette: instrument-blue abyss and ice-white lid, survey-yellow hero, one meaning-bearing cyan reserved exclusively for sound

angle.thesis: Under the ice a machine can fix its own position by listening to sound, while the biological baseline for the animals sharing that water is a 34-year-old number or missing entirely. The precision is all pointed at the robots.
supporting_facts: Up to six fixed acoustic navigation sources at 900 Hz, in place for a year, with gliders trilaterating off them and dead reckoning as the fallback. All certified verbatim from 91 FR 46055.
Beaufort Sea beluga abundance estimate 39,258, CV 0.229, dated 1992.
The Arctic ringed seal stock is ESA-listed threatened and MMPA-depleted, a strategic stock, and its abundance is UNDETERMINED.
angle.fair_counterpoint: ONR has complied with all the requirements of the previous IHAs, the request is for Level B harassment only, and neither ONR nor NMFS expects serious injury or mortality. The film states this on screen and holds it, rather than burying it.
angle.valence: curious, landing on a real open question
runners_up: ENGINEERING WONDER (celebration). Lost because celebration required knowing the data outcome, and the notice never says who receives the observational data.

THE OPEN DOCKET, nobody was asked (open question). Lost outright on the fact-check. The validator could not read FR 46070 to 46079, where the statutorily required subsistence determination sits, so any claim that nobody was consulted is unverifiable and probably false.
AUTONOMY IS NOT AI (open question). Partially GRAFTED IN as the honest disclaimer on line 6 rather than carrying the film, because on its own it is a vocabulary lesson and not a story.

treatment.winner: THE EXPLAINER, grafted with THE ENTHUSIAST's admiration for the engineering and THE DRAMATIST's honest open question
treatment.logline: A machine learns exactly where it is in the one place nobody can see, and the animals in the same water have not been counted since 1992.
treatment.cold_open: A satellite's signal cone reaches down and dies flat against the underside of the sea ice, with the glider a speck in the black below.
treatment.escalation: The hardware plants, the field switches on, three range arcs converge, the iris clamps. Each beat makes the machine MORE certain, which is what makes the turn land.
treatment.the_turn: The same sound that gives the machine certainty is sound in water where whales live, and the count that would let anyone check the no-harm finding is 34 years old or does not exist.
treatment.the_button: A split frame. The machine's position pins exactly. The whale side stays an unfilled outline.
treatment.judge_reasoning: The Explainer wins because this story's whole power is a number comparison a viewer can feel, 1992 against a machine that solves to the metre, and because clarity-as-spectacle is the only lens that can carry an acoustic-positioning explanation in 14 lines. The Enthusiast's genuine admiration is grafted into beats 6 through 11 so the engineering is never sneered at, and the Dramatist's open question supplies the button. The Comedian was deliberately NOT grafted: characterized-object comedy near an ESA-threatened species and Alaska Native subsistence resources would be tonally wrong, and the routine forbids it.

fingerprint.palette: instrument-blue abyss and ice-white lid, survey-yellow hero, one cyan for sound
fingerprint.metaphor: sound as a substitute sky, and an empty pan on a measuring scale

hook.frame1: A satellite signal cone striking the underside of the sea ice and flattening to nothing, with NO SIGNAL legible at frame 0 and the glider a speck in the black below.
hook.headline: The ice blocks the sky
hook.loopback: The button returns to the same machine, now with its position pinned, which is the question from frame 1 answered.

reveals.what: three range arcs chain in from three separate sources and intersect on one point, assembling a position out of nothing but sound
the camera pulls back off a single 1992 data point to reveal 34 entirely empty years, so the absence is discovered by widening rather than announced
the ghost animals resolve into a measuring scale with one pan never loaded

divergence_note: This is the first SUBMERGED dispatch the channel has shipped and the first whose value ladder runs bright-at-top to near-black-at-bottom, inverting every one of the eleven prior biomes, all of which were above water. Versus 2026-07-29 (AURORA-AI) it changes pov (macro-closeup to cross-section-cutaway), layout (grid-modular to stacked-layers), motion_vector (push-in-only to radial-emanate), hero_treatment (single-organic-hero to instrument-as-subject), register (editorial-schematic to naturalistic-scene) and camera_strategy (rise-reveal to locked-drift), which is six of seven. Versus 2026-07-26 (the voter-roll film, a high-key fluorescent cream INTERIOR built on PaperOfficeBG) it changes every axis including light_story, since that piece was flat-lit daylight interior and this is a night-practical world where the only lights are a crack of daylight overhead and the machines' own eyes. The spatial signature (cross-section-cutaway, stacked-layers, radial-emanate) has not been used in the last four dispatches. The palette is new: no prior dispatch has used instrument-blue abyss with a hue reserved exclusively for sound, and cyan appears on no surface anywhere in this film, only on things being heard.

shots.centered: the dead signal cone against the ice lid
shots.means: establish the lid and the dark beneath it

hero.name: UnderIceBG
hero.detail_note: The ice lid is a continuous polygon of flat runs punctuated by three irregular pressure-ridge keels, with a shadowed inner face, brine-channel stipple, fracture chevrons, and a lead of daylight. Three depth zones: far keels, mid ceiling slab, near drifting particulate.

shots.centered: the first ping blooming out of the black

hero.name: AcousticSource
hero.detail_note: Seabed anchor wedge, taut mooring line, ribbed transducer can with rim light and three band lines, a pulse lamp, and emitted ring stack. Zones: seafloor base, mid can, upper line and emitted field.

shots.camera: static:the solve is a diagram and any camera move would fight the geometry the frame is asking you to read
shots.stage3d: flat:the solve is a diagram and depth would fight the geometry
shots.centered: three arcs crossing on the glider, iris clamping

hero.name: IceGlider
hero.detail_note: Hull with five pressure-hull seams, payload bay, mid-body lit and shaded wing pair, CTD sensor stack on the spine, bare swept tail, satellite antenna, socket, iris, brow bar, bezel ticks. Zones: nose face, mid body, tail and antenna.

shots.centered: the ghost beluga crossing the lit sound field

hero.name: Beluga
hero.detail_note: Bulbous melon with wobble idle, ridge line in place of a dorsal, upcurved mouth, fluke, drawn as an UNFILLED ghost outline so the absence of data is the absence of fill. Zones: head and melon, body and fluke.

shots.camera: static:the finding is a document and stillness is the register
shots.stage3d: flat:a document plane has no world to move through
shots.centered: the Level B finding card and the compliance tick

hero.name: StatCard
hero.detail_note: Form-shaded card body with FormGradient, contact shadow, rim light on the light-side edge, big stat line and sub line, plus a drawn compliance tick. Zones: card face, cast shadow ground.

shots.centered: the 1992 point, then 34 empty years revealed by the pullback
shots.means: THE TURN and the scale reveal

hero.name: StatCard
hero.detail_note: Timeline rule with year ticks, one hard 1992 data point, an empty 34-year span, an empty count box for the seal, and a split seam. Zones: the loaded left, the empty right.

shots.centered: the machine pinned, the whale blank

hero.name: IceGlider
hero.detail_note: Same nine-part hero at wide scale with the iris clamped bright, paired across a hard split seam against the unfilled beluga outline. Zones: machine half, seam, blank half.
